newsitem.title: USA: Middlesex Water seeks rate increase.
newsitem.headline: Middlesex Water seeks rate increase.

text.p: Middlesex Water Co said on Wednesday it is seeking a 16.76 percent rate increase, or $5.78 million over current revenues.
The company, which raised its rates most recently in 1993, filed the request with the New Jersey Board of Public Utilities, it said.
The increase is meant to cover costs of maintenance, power, chemicals, insurance, labor and benefits, depreciation, taxes and other expenses, Middlesex Water said.
Middlesex Water is also seeking recognition of 1997 costs to upgrade its treatment facilities to comply with the 1996 Safe Drinking Water Act Amendments.

The average household for the retail service area is currently charged $20.50 for 6,700 gallons of water per month and a 16.7 percent increase would result in a monthly cost of $22.93 for that amount of water, the company said.
